info.title: Make My Day API
info.description: API for the Make My Day iOS and Android apps. Send `Accept: application/json`; authenticated endpoints need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from login or verify-email.

post.description:
Send the identity token and authorization code from
ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential (iOS) or the Apple web flow
(Android), the raw nonce whose SHA-256 was given to Apple, and the
user's name, which Apple only provides the first time.
post.summary: Sign in (or sign up) with Apple

post.description:
For the Android app: send the ID token from Credential Manager's
GoogleIdTokenCredential (requested with the server's web client ID)
and the nonce given to GetGoogleIdOption. The name comes from the token.
post.summary: Sign in (or sign up) with Google

message.const: An account already uses this email address. Log in with your email and password instead.

delete.description:
Confirm with the current password, or a code from
POST /me/deletion-code.
delete.summary:
Delete the account and everything belonging to it. Required by both
the App Store (guideline 5.1.1(v)) and Google Play

post.summary:
Email a code that confirms account deletion, for users who have no
password (Sign in with Apple or Google, passkeys) or have forgotten it

message.const: We have emailed you a code. It expires in 15 minutes.

get.summary:
Plans from today onwards, soonest day first. Venues that have since
been removed are left out

post.summary:
Adds a venue to My Day on a day from today to a year ahead. Adding the
same venue on the same day again returns the existing plan

put.summary: Partial updates are allowed: send only the fields that changed

get.summary:
Saved events that haven't finished, soonest first. ?my_day=1 for only
events in My Day; ?include_past=1 to include finished ones. Events the
crawler has since removed are left out

Keyword search in event titles and descriptions, grouped by venue
(replaces wssearchtext.php). Only events that haven't finished

Type-ahead suggestions for the search box: venue names and London
stations (replaces wsvenuesearch.php and wsareasearch.php)

get.description:
Logged-in users can limit results to their profile interests with
only_my_interests=1; if the parameter is left out, the profile's own
only_my_interests setting applies.
get.summary:
Nearest venues with events on the given day, and nearest venues
without (replaces wsnearme.php). Distances are real great-circle
metres
